helpTake: t <idx>              Capture from the table with the card at idx
helpSteal: s <idx> <seat>       Steal that seat's bundle with the card at idx
helpTrail: d <idx>              Place the card at idx on the table (only when you cannot capture)
rule: Matching a rank on the table captures it -- but an opponent's won bundle has a weak spot: its top card. Play a card of that rank and you take the whole bundle. You cannot place a card while a capture is available; you take from the table or you take a bundle. The card you play becomes the top of your own bundle, so that is what gets aimed at next. Most cards at the end wins.
promptMustCapture: A capture is available. You cannot place a card on the table.
promptNoCapture: No capture is available. Place a card on the table.
promptTrail: trail <idx> ... place a card on the table
gameEndYou: Game over! You collected the most with {{n}} cards.
gameEndCpu: Game over! {{name}} collected the most with {{n}} cards.
hintReasonTrail: Nothing to capture, so play what is least likely to be taken
helpExampleTake: t 0                  take a table card with hand card 0
